source_snapshot.title: Dubai Municipality opens 9,600-square-metre Ghadeer Al Tair Park
source_snapshot.text: DUBAI, 21st November, 2026 (WAM) -- Dubai Municipality has opened the 9,600-square-metre Ghadeer Al Tair Park, the first of 35 new-generation community parks being developed across the emirate. The park reflects a new approach to neighbourhood public spaces, bringing recreational, sports and community facilities closer to residents while enhancing everyday wellbeing and quality of life.The project forms part of Dubai Municipality’s efforts to develop an integrated, people-centred urban environment that encourages active lifestyles, strengthens community connections and makes public spaces an integral part of neighbourhood life, in line with the objectives of the Dubai Parks and Greenery Strategy 2040 and Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan.The opening was attended by Eng. Marwan Ahmed bin Ghalita, Director General of Dubai Municipality, alongside senior Municipality executives and officials, as well as residents of Ghadeer Al Tair and their families, who explored the park’s facilities and participated in recreational and community activities.The new generation of community parks builds on the traditional recreational role of public spaces, introducing a broader concept that integrates sports, recreation and community activities within residential neighbourhoods. By combining accessible facilities with opportunities for social interaction and community participation, these parks are designed to become a natural extension of the neighbourhood, serving residents of all ages and interests.Ghadeer Al Tair Park has been designed to be accessible to surrounding residents within five minutes, encouraging walking, physical activity and more time outdoors. Its open, fence-free design creates direct connections with surrounding residential areas, integrating the park into neighbourhood life while reflecting local identity and community needs.The park offers a range of facilities for the whole family, combining sports, recreation and social interaction. These include two dedicated children’s play areas, one for children aged two to five and another for those aged six to 12, alongside a jogging track and outdoor fitness equipment. A multipurpose hall is also scheduled to open soon, providing additional space for community activities and programmes.At the heart of the park is a dedicated community space designed to host events, gatherings and activities organised by local residents. This flexible space encourages everyday social interaction and provides a venue for neighbourhood celebrations and community-led programmes.Beyond recreation, the park also creates opportunities for entrepreneurs and investors to introduce innovative services and experiences that respond to the needs of residents and visitors, contributing to the continued development of the park as a community destination.Bader Anwahi, CEO of the Public Facilities Agency at Dubai Municipality, said: “With the opening of Ghadeer Al Tair Park, the first of 35 new community parks, we are introducing a broader approach to the development of public spaces in Dubai. Our aim is to create destinations that extend beyond traditional recreation and respond to the everyday needs and interests of the communities they serve.“By designing parks that are open, accessible and closely connected to residential areas, we are making them a natural extension of neighbourhood life. These spaces will provide more opportunities for physical activity, recreation and social interaction, while encouraging residents to play an active role in shaping the experiences and activities within their communities.”He added: “Our approach to developing public parks extends beyond expanding the number of facilities available across Dubai. We are also focused on enhancing the value these spaces bring to residents through thoughtful design, diverse recreational experiences, community-led activities and opportunities for private sector participation.“Through this new generation of community parks, we aim to strengthen neighbourhood connections, encourage healthier and more active lifestyles, and contribute to making Dubai a more attractive, sustainable and liveable city.”The project also supports the objectives of the Blue and Green Spaces Roadmap 2030, launched by Dubai Municipality as part of its comprehensive strategic vision for developing the emirate’s blue and green spaces. The roadmap encompasses projects valued at more than AED4 billion, including the addition of over 120 parks and 200 sports fields and recreational spaces integrated into Dubai’s green networks over a five-year period.Dubai Municipality aims to establish the new generation of community parks as year-round destinations through a diverse programme of activities and experiences tailored to different age groups and interests. This includes seasonal programmes and recreational offerings designed to encourage repeat visits, extend the time residents spend in parks and enhance visitor satisfaction.The design and operation of the new parks also prioritise environmental sustainability, incorporating measures to enhance biodiversity, support climate adaptation and improve resource efficiency.These measures include expanded tree planting, the use of recycled water for irrigation and the adoption of renewable energy solutions. Dubai Municipality will also leverage artificial intelligence and robotics to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen environmental management and optimise resource consumption.Following the opening of Ghadeer Al Tair Park, the remaining parks under Dubai Municipality’s project to develop 35 new community parks are scheduled to open progressively between December 2026 and April 2027.

title: Dubai Municipality opens 9,600-square-metre Ghadeer Al Tair Park
summary_ru: 🚶‍♂️ Открыт новый парк Ghadeer Al Tair площадью 9,600 м² В Дубае открыт первый из 35 новых общественных парков, ориентированных на активный образ жизни и укрепление связей в сообществе. Парк расположен так, чтобы жители могли дойти до него пешком за пять минут. В парке есть детские площадки, беговая дорожка, уличные тренажёры и скоро откроется многофункциональный зал для мероприятий. Проект поддерживает стратегию развития зелёных зон Дубая до 2040 года и включает экологические меры, такие как использование переработанной воды и возобновляемой энергии.
